div.head: III Atr 15
div.ab: Et qui robauerit hominem in luce diei, et in tribus uillis indicabit, non habeatur simile ac si concelasset.
And se þe reafað man leohtan dǽge, ⁊ he hit kyþe to þrim túnan, þæt he ne beo nanes fryðes weorðe.
And se þe reafað man leohtan dǽge ⁊ he hit kyþe to þrim túnan, þæt he ne beo nanes fryðes weorðe.
And if a man robs another in daylight, and the latter makes the deed known in three villages, he shall not be entitled to protection of any kind.
Und wer einen Menschen am lichten Tage beraubt, und [wenn] der es in drei Ortschaften kund macht: dass jener keines Friedenschutzes theilhaftig sei.
And whoever robs a person in broad daylight, and [if] the latter makes it known in three villages: that the robber is not entitled to any protection.
div.note: Quadr.'s version (‘non habeatur simile ac si concelasset’ = let it not be treated as if he had concealed it) differs.
